reason: The README describes an offline HarmonyOS NEXT reference skill for AI coding assistants, centered on indexed documentation retrieval and development guidance, with additional opt-in local automation and device diagnostic scripts.

summaries.zh: 为 AI 编程助手提供 HarmonyOS NEXT 的离线文档检索、开发指导以及可选的本地测试和设备诊断脚本。
summaries.en: Provides AI coding assistants with offline HarmonyOS NEXT documentation retrieval, development guidance, and optional local testing and device diagnostic scripts.

capabilities: Provides offline HarmonyOS NEXT API and development documentation for AI coding assistants
Supports indexed local document retrieval and task- or kit-based navigation
Provides guidance for ArkTS, ArkUI, NDK, IDE tooling, debugging, performance, signing, publishing, and multi-device adaptation
Includes scripts that can install command-line tools, collect device evidence, perform UI actions, audit traces, and manage virtual devices when explicitly run locally
